command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
RANKS=${LMP_RANKS:-16}
echo '9b14e259b99b8a28ebbfd86715524c415f82cd5912c164c3827991ac32f23863  data.rhodo' > d.sha256
sha256sum -c d.sha256
cat > in.rhodo <<'DECK'
units           real
neigh_modify    delay 5 every 1

atom_style      full
bond_style      harmonic
angle_style     charmm
dihedral_style  charmm
improper_style  harmonic
pair_style      lj/charmm/coul/long 8.0 10.0
pair_modify     mix arithmetic
kspace_style    pppm 1e-4

read_data       data.rhodo

replicate       2 2 1

fix             1 all shake 0.0001 5 0 m 1.0 a 232
fix             2 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 100.0 &
                z 0.0 0.0 1000.0 mtk no pchain 0 tchain 1

special_bonds   charmm

thermo          100
thermo_style    multi
timestep        2.0

run             1000
DECK
echo '== rhodopsin: 128,000 atoms, CHARMM, PPPM, SHAKE, NPT 300 K, 1000 steps =='
T0=$(date +%s)
mpiexec -n "$RANKS" --allow-run-as-root --oversubscribe lmp_mpi -in in.rhodo -log lmp.log > lmp.out 2>&1
T1=$(date +%s)
WALL=$(( T1 - T0 ))
# LAMMPS reports the decomposition it actually used. conda-forge ships nompi builds at higher
# build numbers than the openmpi ones, so an unpinned solve can hand back a serial binary that
# under mpiexec -n 16 runs sixteen independent single-rank simulations, each printing plausible
# physics. Reading the task count back is what proves the parallelism happened.
GOTRANKS=$(awk '/MPI tasks/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="MPI"){print $(i-1); exit}}' lmp.log)
NATOMS=$(awk '$2=="atoms" && $1+0>0 {n=$1} END{print n}' lmp.log)
NSDAY=$(awk '/^Performance:/{print $2; exit}' lmp.log)
TSPS=$(awk '/^Performance:/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="timesteps/s,"){print $(i-1); exit}}' lmp.log)
ATOMRATE=$(awk '/^Performance:/{print $(NF-1), $NF; exit}' lmp.log)
LOOP=$(awk '/Loop time of/{print $4; exit}' lmp.log)
STEPS=$(awk '/Loop time of/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="steps"){print $(i-1); exit}}' lmp.log)
TEMP=$(awk '/Temp *=/{t=$NF} END{print t}' lmp.log)
{
  echo "system            rhodopsin, 128,000 atoms, CHARMM + PPPM, NPT"
  echo "atoms             $NATOMS  want 128000 (32,000 replicated 2x2x1)"
  echo "steps             $STEPS  want 1000"
  echo "ranks_requested   $RANKS"
  echo "ranks_used        $GOTRANKS  want $RANKS  (proves MPI, not a nompi fallback)"
  echo "ns_per_day        $NSDAY"
  echo "timesteps_per_s   $TSPS"
  echo "atom_step_rate    $ATOMRATE  (LAMMPS picks katom/Matom by magnitude)"
  echo "loop_time_s       $LOOP"
  echo "wall_s            $WALL  (lmp only)"
  echo "final_temp_K      $TEMP  want 280..330"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
test "$GOTRANKS" = "$RANKS"
test "$NATOMS" = '128000'
test "$STEPS" = '1000'
awk -v n="$NSDAY" 'BEGIN{exit !(n>0)}'
awk -v t="$TEMP" 'BEGIN{exit !(t>280 && t<330)}'
echo 'SMOKE CHECK PASSED'
